categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server bind initialization and credential exposure in src/httpserver.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a local credential theft vulnerability where bitcoind fails open on partial binds. When IPv4 is occupied by a rogue local process but IPv6 binds, bitcoind writes out an RPC cookie that bitcoin-cli subsequently sends in plaintext to the rogue process by default.
